summary: Replacement freezer latch clip with thickened hook and filleted base to resist cold fatigue.
assumptions: overall length 38mm, width 22mm, base 3mm as given
M4 mounting holes 4.2mm dia on 25mm spacing centered on base
striker clearance 8mm gap under hook, 8mm overhang engagement
printed in PETG for -20C toughness vs PLA

parts.name: Freezer Door Latch Clip
parts.purpose: Screws to door with M4 screws and hooks striker to hold door shut

print.orientation: flat on base, hook opening facing sideways, hook arm up
